verdict.rationale: BILL documents recurring bills, a template that creates identical bills for periodic vendor payments. That is a genuine product-native recurring schedule, but it covers only one fixed workflow (bill creation) rather than general scheduled jobs or workflows. Vendor autopay and webhooks are event-triggered rather than time-scheduled, so they do not count as recurring scheduling. Missing for 10: general-purpose scheduling of arbitrary jobs/workflows, documented schedule configuration (frequency, end dates, API control), Spend & Expense-specific recurring automation, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows

citations.quote: A recurring bill is a template for creating identical bills for periodic payments to a vendor.
